about.text: For over a decade, we have crafted premium pet essentials that combine luxury, comfort, and timeless design for discerning pet owners.

Founded by pet lovers and design enthusiasts, LuxePaws began with a simple yet profound vision: to create pet essentials that blend exceptional quality with timeless elegance. What started as a small atelier dedicated to crafting the perfect dog bed has grown into a beloved brand trusted by pet parents worldwide.

Today, guided by our founding principles of quality, comfort, and design, we continue to innovate and craft products that celebrate the special bond between pets and their people. Every piece is thoughtfully designed, meticulously crafted, and made to last.
"Every pet deserves the finest comfort. Every home deserves timeless elegance." - Our Founder
We source only the finest materials and subject every product to rigorous quality checks. Our commitment to excellence ensures your pet receives the very best.
Every product is designed with your pet's comfort, health, and happiness as the priority. We consult with veterinarians and animal behaviorists to ensure optimal design.
We are committed to ethical sourcing and environmentally responsible manufacturing. Our packaging is 100% recyclable, and we use eco-friendly materials whenever possible.

To create premium pet essentials that enhance the lives of pets and their people, combining exceptional craftsmanship with timeless design while maintaining ethical and sustainable practices throughout our process.

Each LuxePaws product begins with a vision, translated into precise sketches by our design team. From these drawings, our skilled artisans select the finest materials and begin the meticulous process of creation.
Our signature construction techniques ensure exceptional durability while maintaining a soft, luxurious feel. Every stitch, every seam is carefully inspected to meet our exacting standards.
LuxePaws is founded in a small workshop, crafting premium dog beds with a focus on comfort and style. The first collection sells out within weeks.
We expand our product line to include grooming essentials, toys, and accessories. Our signature memory foam technology is introduced.
We transition to 100% eco-friendly packaging and begin sourcing sustainable, ethically produced materials for all products.
LuxePaws is recognized as a leading luxury pet brand, featured in top design publications and beloved by pet parents worldwide.
With a global community of devoted pet parents, we continue to innovate, creating timeless pieces that celebrate the bond between pets and their people.
With a background in luxury design and a deep love for animals, Sarah founded LuxePaws to bridge the gap between pet comfort and home aesthetics. Her vision guides every product we create.
A board-certified veterinarian with over 15 years of experience, Dr. Chen ensures every product meets the highest standards of safety and comfort for pets of all ages.
Emma brings a keen eye for detail and a passion for sustainable materials. She leads our design team in creating products that are both beautiful and functional.
David oversees our ethical sourcing initiatives and works to minimize our environmental footprint while maintaining the highest quality standards.

For over a decade, our commitment has remained unwavering: to create pet essentials that not only delight today but become cherished companions for years to come. Every product we create carries this promise forward.

contact.text: We're here to help with any questions about our premium pet essentials, orders, or custom requests. Reach out to our expert team.
123 Luxury Avenue, Fifth FloorNew York, NY 10001United States
How do I determine the right bed size for my pet?

To find the perfect bed size for your pet, measure them from nose to tail while they're lying in their natural sleeping position. Add 6-8 inches for comfort. Our size guide provides detailed measurements for each bed. For most dogs, Small (20" x 16") fits breeds up to 20 lbs, Medium (30" x 24") fits up to 40 lbs, Large (40" x 32") fits up to 80 lbs, and X-Large (48" x 36") fits breeds over 80 lbs.

We offer a 30-day return policy for all unused items in their original condition with all packaging. Pet beds must be unused and in original packaging for return eligibility. Returns are processed within 5-7 business days, and you will receive a full refund to your original payment method. Custom orders and personalized items cannot be returned. Please contact our customer service team to initiate a return.

Yes, we offer worldwide shipping to over 50 countries. Free insured shipping is available on all orders over $100. International delivery typically takes 7-14 business days depending on the destination. Please note that customs fees and import duties may apply and are the responsibility of the recipient. We recommend checking your local customs regulations before placing an order.
How do I care for my pet's new bed?

All our pet beds feature removable, machine-washable covers for easy care. We recommend washing the cover in cold water on a gentle cycle and air drying or tumble drying on low heat. The memory foam insert should be spot cleaned only with mild soap and water, then air dried completely before reassembling. For best results, wash the cover every 2-4 weeks to maintain freshness and hygiene.

Yes, we offer custom embroidery and personalization services for select products including collars, beds, and feeding bowls. You can add your pet's name, initials, or a special date to create a truly unique piece. Custom orders typically take 2-3 weeks for processing and delivery. Please contact our custom design team for availability and pricing on specific items.

product-details.text: Experience the pinnacle of pet comfort with our Heritage Velvet Dog Bed. Crafted with premium velvet fabric and filled with orthopedic memory foam, this bed provides exceptional support for joints and muscles. The luxurious design complements any home decor while giving your furry friend the ultimate relaxation space.

Experience the pinnacle of pet comfort with our Heritage Velvet Dog Bed. Crafted with premium velvet fabric and filled with orthopedic memory foam, this bed provides exceptional support for joints and muscles. The luxurious design complements any home decor while giving your furry friend the ultimate relaxation space.

Our Heritage Velvet Dog Bed is designed with your pet's comfort and your home's aesthetic in mind. The exterior is crafted from premium velvet fabric that is both soft to the touch and durable enough to withstand daily use. The interior features high-density orthopedic memory foam that conforms to your pet's body, providing exceptional support for joints and muscles.

The bed includes a removable, machine-washable cover for easy cleaning, ensuring your pet always has a fresh and hygienic sleeping space. The non-slip bottom keeps the bed securely in place, while the elevated edges provide a sense of security and a perfect spot for resting their head.
Whether your furry friend is a small lap dog or a large breed, this bed offers the perfect combination of luxury, comfort, and durability that discerning pet owners expect.
Shipping:Free insured shipping worldwide. Orders typically ship within 1-2 business days and arrive in 3-7 business days.
Returns:We offer a 30-day return policy. Items must be in original condition with all packaging. Pet beds must be unused and in original packaging for return eligibility.
Warranty:All products come with a 2-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Contact our customer service team for any warranty claims.
Exchange Policy:Free exchanges within 14 days of delivery for size or color changes. Contact us to initiate an exchange.
